definition_en: to clear mud from the bottom of a river or harbour, to lift things from the bottom, or to dust food with flour
core_image: 一艘平底工程船伸出长臂，铁斗从河底抓起黑泥倒进驳船，航道重新露出深水；另一头厨房里一只手举着筛子，把面粉像细雪一样撒在面团上
scene: 退潮后河口露出大片黑泥，工程船把铁斗探进水底，一斗一斗往驳船上倒。Workers dredge the harbour mouth before the ferry season begins.
sceneCN: 这里 dredge 指「清除河底或港底的泥沙使船能通行」（第 1 个义项：疏浚）；句意是渡轮季开始前工人们疏浚港口入口。图中可辨识物件：黑泥滩、铁斗、驳船、长臂吊杆。

senses.title: Clear the bottom
senses.definition: to remove mud and sand from the bottom of a river or harbour so that boats can pass
senses.definitionCN: （动词）清除河底或港底的泥沙使船能通行
senses.example: Workers dredge the harbour mouth before the ferry season begins.
senses.exampleCN: 渡轮季开始前工人们疏浚港口入口。
senses.why: A flat boat reaches a long arm down and lifts bucketfuls of black mud into a barge.
senses.whyCN: 一艘平底船伸出长臂，把一斗斗黑泥提进驳船。

senses.title: Lift from below
senses.definition: to bring something up from the bottom of water with a machine or a net
senses.definitionCN: （动词）用机械或网从水底把东西提上来
senses.example: The crew dredged for oysters along the sandbank.
senses.exampleCN: 船员沿着沙洲采捞牡蛎。
senses.why: A toothed net dragged along the seabed comes up full of shells.
senses.whyCN: 一张带齿的网沿海底拖过，提上来时满是贝壳。

senses.title: Dig up the past
senses.definition: to bring back something forgotten or unpleasant after a long search
senses.definitionCN: （动词）经过长久翻找把被遗忘或不快的事重新提起
senses.example: The reporter dredged up a quarrel from twenty years ago.
senses.exampleCN: 记者翻出了二十年前的一场争吵。
senses.why: A hand reaches into deep silt and pulls out an old rusted key.
senses.whyCN: 一只手探进深深的淤泥，掏出一把生锈的旧钥匙。

senses.title: Dust with flour
senses.definition: to sprinkle flour or sugar lightly over food before cooking
senses.definitionCN: （动词）烹调前在食物上薄薄撒一层面粉或糖
senses.example: Dredge the chicken in flour before it goes into the pan.
senses.exampleCN: 鸡肉下锅前先裹上一层面粉。
senses.why: A sieve held over dough lets a fine white snow fall across it.
senses.whyCN: 一只筛子举在面团上方，让细白的粉末像雪一样落下。

intro.en: Dredge carries two histories in one spelling: a Middle Dutch word for a dragging net gave the sense of clearing mud, and an Old French word for a sugarplum gave the sense of dusting food with powder.
intro.cn: dredge 一个拼写里藏着两条来历：中古荷兰语中指拖网的词给了「清除淤泥」义，古法语中指糖渍果子的词给了「在食物上撒粉」义。

items.en: Greek tragema means a spice or sweetmeat eaten with wine.
items.cn: 希腊语 tragema 指配酒吃的香料或蜜饯。

items.en: Latin tragemata borrows the Greek word for dried fruits and spices.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tragemata 借入希腊词，指干果与香料。

items.en: Old French dragie means a sugarplum, and later a mixture of grains.
items.cn: 古法语 dragie 指糖渍果子，后来指谷物混合粉。

items.en: Middle Dutch dredghe names a net or machine dragged along a riverbed.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 dredghe 指沿河底拖行的网或机械。

items.en: English dredge is recorded for the machine that clears mud from a channel.
items.cn: 英语 dredge 被记录下来，指清除航道淤泥的机械。

items.en: The verb covers clearing waterways, lifting things from the bottom and dusting food with flour.
items.cn: 这个动词涵盖疏浚水道、从水底提物以及在食物上撒粉。

note.en: Dredge shares its soft ending with dodge and drudge, while its neighbours name other ways of taking earth or things out of the ground.
note.cn: dredge 与 dodge、drudge 共用柔和的词尾，而它的近义词则是别的把泥土或东西取出来的方式。

entries.definition: a narrow shelf of rock or a strip fixed to a wall
entries.definitionCN: 岩架；壁架

entries.definition: to remove earth to make a hole or to find old objects

entries.definition: to lift something with a spoon or a curved tool
entries.definitionCN: 用勺或弧形工具舀起

entries.definition: to pull a large net behind a boat to catch fish

dict_mnemonic.text: dredge 的两条来历合在一个词里：一是中古荷兰语 dredghe「拖网、挖泥机」，二是古法语 dragie「糖渍果子、混合粉」。前者让它表示「疏浚、挖出」，后者让它表示「撒粉」。记两个画面：铁斗从河底抓起黑泥＝疏浚；筛子往面团上落白粉＝撒粉。dredge up old memories 是「翻出旧事」，把淤泥里的东西掏出来这个动作被用到了记忆上。

root: 中古荷兰语 dredghe（拖网、挖泥机）／古法语 dragie（糖渍果子、混合粉）→ 英语 dredge（疏浚；撒粉）

sensesIntro.en: Taking things out of a soft bottom: mud lifted into a barge, shells dragged up in a net, an old key pulled from silt and flour sifted over dough.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flat boat lifts bucketfuls of black mud out of a harbour floor while a sieve dusts white flour over dough
core.cn: 核心意象：一艘平底船把一斗斗黑泥从港底提出来，同时一只筛子把白面粉撒在面团上

branches.en: Both take material off a water bottom.
branches.cn: 两者都从水底取走物质。

intro.en: Dredge comes from a Dutch dragging net; -er and -ing build the machine and the work, while Latin trah- and cav- name pulling and hollowing from another direction.
intro.cn: dredge 来自荷兰语的拖网；-er 与 -ing 造出机器与作业，而拉丁语 trah- 与 cav- 从另一个方向指称拉与挖空。

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere means to draw or pull, excavare to hollow out and cavus hollow.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉、拖，excavare 意为挖空，cavus 意为空的。

definition_zh: 漂流；漂移；趋势；要旨；堆积物；漂泊
definition_en: to be carried slowly by water or air, or a slow general movement or meaning
core_image: 一只空瓶随水流缓缓转向，没有人在掌舵
scene: 河面上起了风，一张纸片贴着水面慢慢滑向桥洞。The empty boat began to drift toward the far bank.
sceneCN: 这里 drift 是「漂流」（第 1 个义项）；句意是那条空船开始向对岸漂去。

pos.zh: 漂流；漂泊；逐渐变化
漂流；趋势；要旨；堆积物

senses.title: To be carried along by water or air
senses.definition: to move slowly on water or in the air without being controlled
senses.definitionCN: 在水面或空中缓慢移动，且不受控制
senses.example: The raft drifted out to sea during the night.
senses.exampleCN: 夜里木筏漂到了海上。
senses.why: The word began as a noun for a driving force, then came to mean being driven along passively by water or wind.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指「驱赶之力」，后来转指被水流或风被动地推着走，也就是漂流。

senses.title: To change or move gradually
senses.titleCN: 逐渐变化；不知不觉陷入
senses.definition: to move or change slowly, often without a clear plan
senses.definitionCN: 缓慢地移动或变化，往往没有明确计划
senses.example: The conversation drifted onto another subject.
senses.exampleCN: 谈话不知不觉转到了别的话题上。
senses.why: Speech that is not steered follows the current of thought the way a boat follows water, hence gradual unplanned change.
senses.whyCN: 没有被掌舵的谈话顺着思绪的水流走，正如船顺水而行，于是有了「不知不觉地变化」。

senses.title: A mass piled up by wind or water
senses.definition: a pile of snow, sand, or leaves heaped up by wind or water
senses.definitionCN: 被风或水堆起的一堆雪、沙或落叶
senses.example: A snow drift blocked the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 一堆积雪堵住了大门。
senses.why: Material carried by wind settles where the current slows, and the heap left behind takes the name of the drifting.
senses.whyCN: 被风带走的物质在气流变慢处落下，留下的一堆就沿用了「漂移」之名。

senses.title: The general meaning of what is said
senses.definition: the main point or general meaning of speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 言语或文字的主要意思与大致方向
senses.example: I did not catch the drift of his argument.
senses.exampleCN: 我没听懂他论证的大意。
senses.why: Meaning, like water, has a direction, so following the drift means following where the argument is heading.
senses.whyCN: 意义像水一样有方向，所以「顺着漂移」就是顺着论述要去的方向理解。

senses.title: A slow change in conditions or opinion
senses.definition: a gradual movement of prices, opinions, or events in one direction
senses.definitionCN: 价格、舆论或事件朝某一方向的缓慢移动
senses.example: There is a drift toward shorter working weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 现在存在一种朝更短工作周演变的趋势。
senses.why: Many small unforced movements add up to a direction, and that accumulated direction is also called a drift.
senses.whyCN: 许多微小的、非强制的移动累积成一个方向，这个累积出的方向也叫 drift。

intro.en: Drift comes from Old English drifan, to drive, and first named the act or force of driving.
intro.cn: drift 来自古英语 drifan（驱赶、推动），最初指「驱动」这一动作或力量。

items.en: A Germanic root meaning to drive lies behind the word; it is also the source of drive.
items.cn: 这个词背后有一个表示「驱赶」的日耳曼语词根，drive 也出自同一处。

items.en: Drifan meant to drive or force along, especially animals or ships.
items.cn: drifan 意为「驱赶、推动」，多用于牲畜或船只。

items.en: The noun drift named a driving force, then a slow course set by water or wind.
items.cn: 名词 drift 指驱动力，随后指由水流或风设定的缓慢路径。

items.en: The sense of a pile heaped by wind is recorded, and the meaning of general purport followed.
items.cn: 「被风堆起的一堆」这一义项有记录，随后又出现「大意、要旨」义。

items.en: The word extended to gradual social and economic trends and to aimless wandering.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到社会与经济的渐变趋势，以及漫无目的的漂泊。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the driving root; the near-meaning group separates floating from wandering.
note.cn: 形近组共享「驱动」词根；近义组把「漂浮」与「漫游」分开。

entries.definition: To operate a vehicle or to force something forward.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「驾驶；驱动」，与 drift 同源。

entries.definition: A person who moves from place to place without a fixed home.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「漂泊者」，由 drift 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: Floating without control or without a fixed course.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「漂流无依的」，由 a- 加 drift 构成。

entries.definition: To rest on water without sinking, without implying movement.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「漂浮」，只讲不沉，不含移动。

entries.definition: To walk around without a clear direction, usually on land.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「漫游」，多指陆地行走。

entries.definition: A general direction in which something is developing.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「趋势」，与 drift 的第五个义项接近。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow one driving root into water, speech, snow and social change.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着同一个「驱动」词根，走进水、言语、积雪与社会变化。

normal.en: Drift and drive are cousins: one pushes, the other is pushed along.
normal.cn: drift 与 drive 是表亲：一个在推，一个被推着走。

normal.en: A boat with no one at the wheel can only drift.
normal.cn: 没人掌舵的船只能漂流。

normal.en: Speech that loses its steering drifts onto other topics.
normal.cn: 失去操控的谈话就会漂到别的话题上。

normal.en: Snow carried by wind is left as a drift at the gate.
normal.cn: 被风带走的雪会在大门处堆成一堆。

normal.en: Catch the drift means follow where the meaning is flowing.
normal.cn: catch the drift 就是顺着意义流动的方向听懂大意。

abstract.en: Picture an empty bottle turning slowly in a current.
abstract.cn: 想象一只空瓶在水流里缓缓转向。

abstract.en: Picture snow piling against a wall in a long wedge.
abstract.cn: 想象雪在墙边堆成一条长长的楔形。

abstract.en: Picture a conversation sliding off its first topic.
abstract.cn: 想象一场谈话从最初的话题上滑开。

examples.en: The balloon drifted east with the morning wind.
examples.cn: 气球随晨风向东飘去。

examples.en: He drifted off before the film had ended.
examples.cn: 电影还没放完他就睡着了。

examples.en: The drift of her letter was that she needed more time.
examples.cn: 她那封信的大意是她需要更多时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「追风」——被风追着走、自己在动却没有方向，就是 drift 的「漂流、渐趋」。

root: 来自古英语 drifan（驱赶、推动），属日耳曼语词族，与 drive 同源。本义为「驱动」，后转为「被水流或风推着走」，再引申为「堆积物」「大意」「逐渐变化的趋势」与「漂泊」。

sensesIntro.en: One image of being pushed without steering covers water, speech, snow heaps, and slow social change.
sensesIntro.cn: 「被推着走却无人掌舵」这一个画面，覆盖水上漂流、谈话转向、积雪成堆与缓慢的社会变化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an empty bottle turning slowly in a current.
core.cn: 核心意象：空瓶在水流里缓缓转向。

branches.en: WATER AND AIR: the physical sense is passive movement on a current.
branches.cn: 水与风线：物理义是在水流中被动移动，即第一个义项。

branches.en: CHANGE: unsteered movement becomes gradual drift in talk and in society.
branches.cn: 变化线：无人操控的移动变成谈话与社会的渐变，即第二、五个义项。

branches.en: THE HEAP: what a current drops stays as a drift.
branches.cn: 堆积线：水流或风放下的东西留成一堆，即第三个义项。

branches.en: MEANING: following the drift is following where the sense flows.
branches.cn: 意义线：顺着漂移走，就是顺着意义流动的方向，即第四个义项。

branches.en: Water and words share a current, which is why both can be drifted along.
branches.cn: 水与言语共享一股「流」，所以两者都能被顺着带走。

intro.en: Drift is a Germanic root word that accepts English endings and a small prefix.
intro.cn: drift 是日耳曼语根词，可接英语词尾与一个小前缀。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin element in drift itself; the noun ending -er and the prefix a- are English.
latinIntro.cn: drift 本身没有拉丁成分；名词词尾 -er 与前缀 a- 都是英语的。

items.example: The verb is the source of both drive and drift.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词同时是 drive 与 drift 的来源。

definition_zh: 钻头；钻孔；操练；反复练习；演习
definition_en: a tool for making holes, or repeated practice of a skill
core_image: 钻头贴着墙面旋转，粉末一圈圈落下
scene: 工地上电钻声不断，墙面上很快多出一排整齐的小孔。He used a drill to make holes in the wall.
sceneCN: 这里 drill 是「钻头」（第 1 个义项）；句意是他用钻头在墙上打孔。

pos.zh: 钻头；操练；演习
钻孔；反复训练

senses.title: A tool for making holes
senses.definition: a tool or machine with a pointed turning bit, used to make holes
senses.definitionCN: 带尖头旋转刀头、用来打孔的工具或机器
senses.example: The electric drill is too heavy for this shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 这把电钻对这个架子来说太重了。
senses.why: The tool's name probably comes from a word for turning or boring, and the turning bit is exactly what makes the hole.
senses.whyCN: 这件工具的名字很可能来自表示「旋转、钻孔」的词，而正是那枚旋转的刀头造成了孔洞。

senses.title: To make a hole with a drill
senses.definition: to make a hole in something with a tool or machine
senses.definitionCN: 用工具或机器在某物上打出孔洞
senses.example: They drilled through the concrete floor.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在混凝土楼板上钻穿了孔。
senses.why: The verb names the action performed by the tool, so both share one form.
senses.whyCN: 动词命名的是这件工具执行的动作，所以两者共用一个形式。

senses.title: Repeated practice of a skill
senses.definition: a training exercise in which an action is repeated many times
senses.definitionCN: 把某个动作重复许多遍的训练
senses.example: The class spent ten minutes on a grammar drill.
senses.exampleCN: 班上花了十分钟做语法操练。
senses.why: This sense is a separate word from the tool, probably from a verb meaning to turn or whirl, and repetition copies that circular motion.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自另一个词，很可能源自表示「旋转、打转」的动词，反复练习正复制了那种兜圈的动作。

senses.title: An emergency practice run
senses.definition: a planned practice of what to do in an emergency or a military operation
senses.definitionCN: 为应对紧急情况或军事行动而进行的预演
senses.example: A fire drill is held every term.
senses.exampleCN: 每个学期都会举行一次消防演习。
senses.why: A drill rehearses movements until they become automatic, which is the same repetition as a classroom exercise.
senses.whyCN: 演习把动作练到不用思考，这和课堂操练是同一种重复。

intro.en: Two words have merged in English: one for a boring tool and one for repeated training; both origins are uncertain.
intro.cn: 英语里合并了两个词：一个指钻孔工具，一个指反复训练；两者的来源都不确定。

items.en: One likely source is a Dutch verb for boring or turning; the link is plausible but not certain.
items.cn: 一个可能来源是表示「钻孔、旋转」的荷兰语动词；这条联系合理但不确定。

items.en: The tool sense appears in English writing and spread quickly with mining and carpentry.
items.cn: 工具义在英语文献中出现，并随采矿与木工迅速传播。

items.en: The training sense may come from a Germanic verb meaning to turn or whirl, used for troops.
items.cn: 训练义可能来自表示「旋转、打转」的日耳曼语动词，最初用于军队。

items.en: Military drill was extended to schools and to any repeated exercise.
items.cn: 军事操练扩展到学校，并泛指任何重复练习。

items.en: The two senses are now written identically, though their histories remain separate and unsettled.
items.cn: 两个义项今天拼写相同，但它们的历史仍然相互独立且未有定论。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the stem; the near-meaning group separates boring from practising.
note.cn: 形近组共享词干；近义组把「钻孔」与「操练」分开。

entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「钻头刀头」，是 drill 的固定搭配。

entries.definition: To make a deep round hole, often in soil or metal.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「钻凿」，多用于土或金属，语体偏正式。

entries.definition: Repeated activity to improve a skill, without the military tone.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「练习」，不含军事色彩。

entries.definition: A task done for training, often written or physical.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「练习、习题」，范围比 drill 宽。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the two separate words apart while sharing one spelling.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子把两个独立的词分开，同时记住它们共用一个拼写。

normal.en: The tool turns a bit; the training repeats a turn.
normal.cn: 工具让刀头旋转；训练让动作一遍遍重复。

normal.en: A drill bit and a fire drill share only the letters, not the history.
normal.cn: drill bit 与 fire drill 只共享字母，不共享历史。

normal.en: Drilling a hole is quick; drilling a class takes repetition.
normal.cn: 钻孔很快；操练一个班级却要靠重复。

normal.en: Both origins are uncertain, so no single root should be invented.
normal.cn: 两个来源都不确定，不该硬造出一个统一词根。

normal.en: A fire drill rehearses the moves until nobody has to think.
normal.cn: 消防演习把动作练到没人需要再思考。

abstract.cn: 想象一个班齐声重复同一句话。

root: 英语中合并了两个来源不同的词：一为钻孔工具，可能经荷兰语 drillen（钻孔、旋转）而来；二为反复操练，可能出自表示「旋转、打转」的日耳曼语动词，最初用于军队训练。两者来源均无定论，不宜强行归并为一个词根。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bit turning against a wall while powder falls.
core.cn: 核心意象：刀头贴着墙面旋转，粉末落下。

branches.en: THE TOOL: the turning bit gives the object its name.
branches.cn: 工具线：旋转的刀头给这件器物命名，即第一个义项。

branches.en: THE ACTION: the verb repeats what the tool does.
branches.cn: 动作线：动词重复这枚工具所做的事，即第二个义项。

branches.en: REPETITION: repeated movement becomes classroom practice.
branches.cn: 重复线：反复的动作变成课堂操练，即第三个义项。

branches.en: REHEARSAL: practice under pressure turns into an emergency drill.
branches.cn: 预演线：带压力的练习变成紧急演习，即第四个义项。

branches.en: Grammar drills and fire drills both aim at automatic response.
branches.cn: 语法操练与消防演习，都以「不用思考就能反应」为目标。

intro.en: Drizzle is a frequentative built on an old verb meaning to fall: the ending repeats the action, so drizzle is falling again and again in the smallest drops.
intro.cn: drizzle 是在一个意为「落下」的古老动词上加反复体构成的：这个词尾让动作反复，所以 drizzle 就是以最细小的水珠一次次落下。

items.en: Old English dreosan means to fall.
items.cn: 古英语 dreosan 意为落下。

items.en: Middle English drusen means to fall in drops.
items.cn: 中古英语 drusen 意为成滴落下。

items.en: The frequentative form drizzle appears for very fine rain.

items.en: The adjective drizzly describes weather of fine steady rain.
items.cn: 形容词 drizzly 用来描述细雨连绵的天气。

items.cn: 烹饪书用 drizzle 表示把细流淋在菜上。

note.en: Drizzle shares its busy ending with dazzle and grizzle, while its neighbours name other light ways of wetting a surface.

dict_mnemonic.text: drizzle ＝ 古英语 drēosan（落下）＋ 反复后缀 -le ＝「一次次细细地落」。所以它不是 shower（阵雨）也不是 downpour（暴雨），而是几乎看不见水珠、只把路面弄亮的毛毛雨。厨房里的 drizzle with oil 是同一画面：把油拉成一条细线淋下去。同族的 mizzle 是「雾＋细雨」，形容词 drizzly 说的是那种整天阴湿的天气。

normal.en: A bagpipe holding one low note under the tune.
normal.cn: 风笛在旋律下面托着一个不断的低音。

normal.en: A delivery box lowered from four spinning arms onto a doorstep.
normal.cn: 一只送货箱从四条旋转的臂下放到门阶上。

abstract.en: Four small propellers hold a camera steady above the wheat while its shadow slides across the ears.
abstract.cn: 四个小螺旋桨把一台摄像机稳稳托在麦田上方，影子在麦穗上滑过。

abstract.en: A fat bee waits at the hive door while the others come home heavy with pollen.
abstract.cn: 一只肥壮的蜜蜂在巢门口等着，别的蜜蜂带着满身花粉回来。

abstract.en: A grey box on a pole gives out one unbroken note that never rises or falls.
abstract.cn: 电线杆上的灰盒子发出一个不断的音，不高也不低。

examples.en: A drone hovered over the wheat field and mapped every row.
examples.cn: 一架无人机悬在麦田上方，把每一行都测绘下来。

examples.en: The drone of the transformer kept the whole yard awake.
examples.cn: 变压器的嗡鸣让整个院子睡不着。

examples.en: He droned on about the timetable until half the room looked away.
examples.cn: 他没完没了地念时间表，直到半个房间的人把目光移开。

dict_mnemonic.text: drone 本义是「雄蜂」——古英语 drān。雄蜂不采蜜，只在巢里嗡嗡叫，于是这个词先变成「低沉不断的嗡鸣」，再变成「单调冗长地说」，常见搭配是 drone on。20 世纪人们把嗡嗡飞行、无人驾驶的小飞机也叫 drone，因为它像雄蜂一样悬在空中发出声音。记一条线：雄蜂 → 嗡鸣 → 无人机。

root: 古英语 drān（雄蜂）→ 低沉嗡鸣 → 20 世纪 drone（无人机）

sensesIntro.en: One unbroken low note: a camera held above wheat, an idle bee at the hive door, a transformer humming on a pole and a reader holding one flat tone.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个不断的低音：托在麦田上方的摄像机、巢门口不干活的雄蜂、电线杆上嗡鸣的变压器，以及保持一个平板调子的朗读者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: four propellers hold a camera above a wheat field while a fat idle bee waits at the hive door and a transformer hums one unbroken note
core.cn: 核心意象：四个螺旋桨把摄像机托在麦田上方，同时一只肥壮而闲散的雄蜂等在巢门口，变压器发出一个不断的低音

branches.en: A craft that flies with nobody aboard.
branches.cn: 机上无人的飞行器。

branches.en: The bee that hums but does no work.
branches.cn: 会嗡鸣却不干活的蜂。

branches.en: One low note that never stops.
branches.cn: 一个永不停的低音。

branches.en: A voice held at that same flat note.
branches.cn: 保持在同一平板音上的嗓音。

branches.en: The bee gives the sound its name.
branches.cn: 蜂把名字给了这种声音。

intro.en: Drone is an Old English bee name; -ish builds dronish, while son- and phon- name sound and vol- and rot- name flying and wheels.
intro.cn: drone 是古英语的蜂名；-ish 造出 dronish，而 son- 与 phon- 指称声音，vol- 与 rot- 指称飞与轮。

latinIntro.en: Latin sonus means sound, volare to fly and rota a wheel.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sonus 意为声音，volare 意为飞，rota 意为轮。

definition_zh: 滴落；落下；下降；顺路放下；放弃；一滴；跌幅
definition_en: to fall in small amounts, to let something fall, to become lower, to leave someone somewhere, to leave something out, or a small amount of liquid and the fall it makes
core_image: 水珠从叶尖脱手，坠向石阶的一瞬
scene: 屋檐下的水珠一颗接一颗砸在石阶上。A single drop fell from the leaf and broke on the stone.
sceneCN: 这里 drop 是「一滴」（第 6 个义项：液体的一小滴）；句意是一滴水珠从叶上落下，在石头上碎开。

pos.zh: 滴落；落下；下降；顺路放下；放弃
一滴；少量；下降；落差

senses.title: To fall in drops
senses.definition: to fall in single drops, as a liquid does from a roof, a tap or a leaf
senses.definitionCN: 以单颗液滴的形式落下，如从屋顶、水龙头或叶子上滴落
senses.example: Water dropped from the leaking pipe all night.
senses.exampleCN: 漏水的水管整夜都在往下滴水。
senses.why: This is the word at its origin: the noun for a single bead of liquid turned into the motion that bead makes.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词的源头：表示单颗液滴的名词，变成了这颗液滴所做的动作。

senses.title: To fall or let fall
senses.definition: to fall suddenly, or to release something so that it falls, often by accident
senses.definitionCN: 突然落下，或松手让某物掉落，常属意外
senses.example: She dropped the keys on the table.
senses.exampleCN: 她把钥匙掉在了桌上。
senses.why: From liquid falling the verb widened to any object that leaves the hand, keeping the same downward motion.
senses.whyCN: 从液体滴落扩展到任何离开手的物体，向下这个动作保持不变。

senses.title: To become lower
senses.definition: to decrease in amount, level, temperature, price or value
senses.definitionCN: 在数量、水平、温度、价格或价值上降低
senses.example: Temperatures drop sharply after sunset.
senses.exampleCN: 日落后气温急剧下降。
senses.why: A falling object and a falling number share the same downward line, so the verb moved easily from the physical to the measurable.
senses.whyCN: 落下的物体与下跌的数字共享同一条向下的线，动词于是很容易从物理世界跨到可度量之物。

senses.title: To leave someone somewhere
senses.definition: to take a person or thing to a place and leave them there, often on the way to somewhere else
senses.definitionCN: 把人或物送到某处并留在那里，通常是在去别处的路上
senses.example: He dropped his sister at the station.
senses.exampleCN: 他把妹妹送到了车站。
senses.why: The passenger is 'dropped' the way a parcel is set down: the vehicle stops, the person leaves, the trip goes on.
senses.whyCN: 乘客就像被放下的包裹：车停下、人离开、行程继续，所以用 drop。

senses.title: To leave out or stop
senses.definition: to leave something out of a plan, list or story, or to stop doing something
senses.definitionCN: 把某事物从计划、名单或报道中删去，或停止做某事
senses.example: The magazine dropped the story at the last minute.
senses.exampleCN: 杂志在最后一刻撤下了那篇报道。
senses.why: Something removed from a plan falls out of it, so the physical fall becomes a metaphor for withdrawal.
senses.whyCN: 从计划中被删去的东西像是掉了出去，于是物理上的「落」变成了「撤回」的比喻。

senses.title: A small amount of liquid
senses.definition: a small rounded amount of liquid that falls or hangs from something
senses.definitionCN: 从某物落下或悬挂着的一小颗圆形液体
senses.example: A drop of oil stained the page.
senses.exampleCN: 一滴油在书页上留下了污渍。
senses.why: This is the original noun: the shape a liquid takes when surface tension holds it together before it falls.
senses.whyCN: 这是原始的名词义：液体在落下之前被表面张力聚成的那个形状。

senses.title: A fall in amount
senses.definition: a fall or decrease in amount, level, price or value
senses.definitionCN: 数量、水平、价格或价值的下降或减少
senses.example: The company reported a sharp drop in sales.
senses.exampleCN: 公司报告销售额急剧下降。
senses.why: The verb's downward motion returns as a noun, now measuring how far a figure has fallen.
senses.whyCN: 动词的向下运动又变回名词，用来衡量一个数字跌了多远。

intro.en: Drop belongs to the same Germanic family as drip; a noun for the bead of liquid came first, and the verb grew from it.
intro.cn: drop 与 drip 同属一个日耳曼语词族；先有表示液滴的名词，动词再从它生长出来。

items.en: A root connected with dripping or falling in small amounts is generally reconstructed, but its exact shape is uncertain.
items.cn: 一般会重构出一个与「滴落、少量落下」相关的词根，但其确切形式不确定。

items.en: The Germanic noun for a drop is reconstructed with a shape close to drup-, and the related verb underlies drip.
items.cn: 日耳曼语中表示「一滴」的名词被重构为接近 drup- 的形式，相关的动词则是 drip 的来源。

items.en: Old English dropa meant a drop of liquid, and the verb dropian is also recorded.
items.cn: 古英语 dropa 意为「一滴液体」，动词 dropian 也有记录。

items.en: Middle English drope kept the noun, while the verb spread from liquids to any falling object.
items.cn: 中古英语 drope 保留了名词，动词则从液体扩展到任何下落的物体。

items.en: The verb gained the senses of letting something fall and of leaving a person at a place.
items.cn: 动词发展出「让某物落下」和「把人放在某处」的义项。

items.en: Business and journalism turned drop into a measure of decline, as in a sharp drop in sales.
items.cn: 商业与新闻业把 drop 变成衡量跌幅的词，如销售额的急剧下降。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same dripping family or with a similar shape; the near-meaning group gathers other verbs of falling and declining.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「滴落」词族的词或外形相近的词；近义组收其他表示「落下、下降」的动词。

entries.definition: A very small drop of liquid; formed from drop with the diminutive suffix -let.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指极小的液滴，由 drop 加指小后缀 -let 构成。

entries.definition: To fall in drops slowly and regularly, or the sound and liquid of such a fall.
entries.definitionCN: 动词或名词，指缓慢而有规律地滴落，也指滴落的声音和液体。

entries.definition: To bend or hang downward, as a tired flower does; a different word despite the similar shape.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「下垂、萎靡」，如疲倦的花朵；虽然外形相近，却是另一个词。

entries.definition: A person who leaves school or a course before finishing; drop plus out.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指中途退学或退出课程的人，由 drop 加 out 构成。

entries.definition: To move downward under gravity; the most general verb for the motion.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「落下」，是表示这一运动最通用的词。

entries.definition: To become smaller or weaker over time; more gradual and formal than drop.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「下降、衰退」，比 drop 更渐进、更正式。

entries.definition: To become less in number or size; neutral and measurable.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「减少」，中性且可度量。

entries.definition: To fall or drop suddenly and steeply; stronger and more dramatic than drop.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「骤降、猛跌」，比 drop 更强烈、更具戏剧性。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from the single bead of water and follow it down into prices, passengers and cancelled plans.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从那一小颗水珠出发，跟着它一路落到价格、乘客和被取消的计划里。

normal.en: Picture one bead of water at the tip of a leaf: that bead is a drop.
normal.cn: 想象叶尖上的一颗水珠：这颗水珠就是一个 drop。

normal.en: The verb is regular: drop, dropped, dropped, dropping; double the final p before -ed and -ing.
normal.cn: 这个动词是规则的：drop、dropped、dropped、dropping；加 -ed 和 -ing 前要双写词尾的 p。

normal.en: Prices drop, temperatures drop and sales drop: the same downward line drawn on a chart.
normal.cn: 价格 drop、气温 drop、销售 drop，都是图表上同一条向下的线。

normal.en: Drop someone off means set them down and drive on; drop a plan means set the plan down for good.
normal.cn: drop someone off 是把人放下后继续开车；drop a plan 是把计划永久放下。

normal.en: A drop of rain and a sharp drop in sales use the same noun for two very different falls.
normal.cn: a drop of rain 与 a sharp drop in sales 用同一个名词表示两种截然不同的下落。

abstract.en: Picture a bead of water shrinking as it falls, then landing as a circle on stone.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗水珠在下落中收缩，最后在石头上落成一个圆。

abstract.en: The same bead can be redrawn as a point on a graph sliding down the y-axis.
abstract.cn: 同一颗水珠可以被重画成图表上沿纵轴下滑的一个点。

abstract.en: Every sense of drop is one small thing leaving a higher place for a lower one.
abstract.cn: drop 的每个义项，都是一件小东西从高处离开、去往低处。

examples.en: A drop of rain rolled down the window.
examples.cn: 一滴雨顺着窗玻璃滚了下来。

examples.en: Prices dropped sharply after the new supply arrived.
examples.cn: 新货源到达后，价格急剧下跌。

examples.en: Could you drop me at the next corner?
examples.cn: 你能在下一个路口让我下车吗？

dict_mnemonic.text: drop 本是一颗水滴，动词就是这颗水滴往下落；由「落下」再引申出下降、放下、放弃。

root: 古英语 dropa 意为「一滴液体」，与 drip 同属一个日耳曼语词族，其名词先于动词出现；中古英语 drope 保留名词，动词逐渐从液体扩展到一切下落之物。更早的印欧语词根一般与「滴落」相关，确切形式不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses of drop all describe one small amount leaving a higher place: liquid, an object, a number, a passenger, a plan, or the measured fall itself.
sensesIntro.cn: drop 的七个义项都在描述「一小份东西离开高处」：液体、物体、数字、乘客、计划，或这次下落本身的幅度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one bead of water leaves a leaf and falls to the stone below.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗水珠离开叶子，坠向下面的石头。

branches.en: THE BEAD: the noun at its most concrete, a single rounded piece of liquid.
branches.cn: 水珠线：名词最具体的一端，一颗圆形的液体。

branches.en: THE FALL: liquid falls by itself, and a hand can let an object fall the same way.
branches.cn: 下落线：液体自行落下，手也能以同样的方式让物体落下。

branches.en: THE CHART: the downward line is redrawn as falling prices and temperatures.
branches.cn: 图表线：这条向下的线被重画成下跌的价格与气温。

branches.en: THE LEAVING: a passenger is set down, and a plan is set down for good.
branches.cn: 离开线：乘客被放下，计划也被永久放下。

branches.en: THE MEASURE: the noun returns to name how far a figure has fallen.
branches.cn: 度量线：名词回来指一个数字跌了多远。

intro.en: Drop is a native Germanic noun-verb pair; its family is built with native suffixes and compounds.
intro.cn: drop 是本族语的日耳曼语名动同形词；词族靠本族语后缀和复合构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; Latin gutta, a drop, is a semantic counterpart rather than an ancestor.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 gutta（一滴）只是语义上的对应，并非祖先。

items.meaning: a bead of liquid; to fall
items.example: The same shape serves as noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 同一个形态兼作名词与动词。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加指小后缀 -let 构成，义为「小水滴」
由本词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「滴管；滴瓶」
由本词与 out 复合，义为「退学者；退出者」

definition_zh: n. 小滴；微滴；小水珠；（医学）飞沫
definition_en: a very small drop of liquid, a round bead resting on a surface, or a tiny liquid particle carried in the air
core_image: 一片荷叶上滚着几十颗亮晶晶的小水珠，风一过就合并滑落；冷管末端挂着一颗不肯落下的圆珠；阳光下按下喷雾瓶，显出一团几乎看不见的细点
scene: 清晨的荷叶上滚着几十颗亮晶晶的小水珠，风一过它们就合并成一颗滑落。Every droplet on the lotus leaf caught the early light.
sceneCN: 这里 droplet 指「极小的一滴液体」（第 1 个义项：小滴）；句意是荷叶上的每一颗小水珠都映着晨光。图中可辨识物件：荷叶、滚动的水珠、合并后滑落的一颗、晨光。

pos.zh: 小滴；微滴；小水珠；（医学）飞沫

senses.title: A very small drop
senses.definition: a very small drop of liquid
senses.definitionCN: （名词）极小的一滴液体
senses.example: Every droplet on the lotus leaf caught the early light.
senses.exampleCN: 荷叶上的每一颗小水珠都映着晨光。
senses.why: Dozens of bright beads roll on a leaf and merge into one when the wind moves it.
senses.whyCN: 几十颗亮珠在叶面上滚动，风一动就合并成一颗。

senses.title: A bead on a surface
senses.definition: a small round bead of liquid resting on a surface without spreading
senses.definitionCN: （名词）停在表面而不摊开的小圆液珠
senses.example: Condensation left a droplet at the tip of each cold pipe.
senses.exampleCN: 冷凝水在每根冷管的末端留下一颗小水珠。
senses.why: A round bead hangs at the end of a pipe, held together by its own skin.
senses.whyCN: 一颗圆珠挂在管口，被自身的那层膜拢在一起。

senses.title: A particle in air
senses.definition: a tiny particle of liquid carried in the air, especially one that can carry infection
senses.definitionCN: （名词）悬浮在空气中的极小液体颗粒，尤指能携带病原的飞沫
senses.example: A cough releases droplets that can hang in a still room.
senses.exampleCN: 一声咳嗽释放出的飞沫能悬在不通风的房间里。
senses.why: A spray bottle pressed in sunlight shows a cloud of dots too small to see singly.
senses.whyCN: 在阳光下按下喷雾瓶，显出一团小到无法单独看见的点。

intro.en: Droplet is drop plus the diminutive ending -let, borrowed through French; the ending shrinks whatever it attaches to, so a droplet is a drop made small.
intro.cn: droplet 由 drop 加指小后缀 -let 组成，这个后缀经法语借入；它把所附之物缩小，所以 droplet 就是被变小的一滴。

items.en: Old English dropa means a drop of liquid.
items.cn: 古英语 dropa 意为一滴液体。

items.en: Old French -elet is a diminutive ending meaning small.
items.cn: 古法语 -elet 是指小的后缀。

items.en: English droplet is recorded for a very small drop.
items.cn: 英语 droplet 被记录下来，指极小的一滴。

items.en: Scientists use droplet for a small mass of liquid in a spray or a cloud.
items.cn: 科学家用 droplet 指喷雾或云中的一小团液体。

items.en: Droplet becomes the standard term for particles that carry infection through the air.
items.cn: droplet 成为指称经空气传播病原的颗粒的标准术语。

items.en: The word covers dew beads, ink dots and the fine mist of a spray.
items.cn: 这个词涵盖露珠、墨点与喷雾的细雾。

note.en: Droplet shares the shrinking ending -let with leaflet and booklet, while its neighbours name other very small round or airborne things.
note.cn: droplet 与 leaflet、booklet 共用那个「变小」的后缀 -let，而它的近义词则指别的极小圆形物或悬浮物。

entries.definitionCN: 极少量；细流

entries.definition: a small leaf, or a single printed sheet handed out
entries.definitionCN: 小叶；散发的传单

entries.definition: a small thin book with paper covers
entries.definitionCN: 小册子

entries.definition: a very small spot or particle
entries.definitionCN: 极小的斑点或微粒

entries.definitionCN: 悬浮在气体中的极细固体或液体微粒

definition_zh: 干旱；旱灾；长期缺雨；（资源、机会的）长期匮乏
definition_en: a prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall that causes water shortage; also a long scarcity of anything
core_image: 水库退成一片龟裂的泥滩，旧船坞悬在干岸上方，远处只剩一条细水
scene: 连续第三年缺雨，水库退成一片龟裂的泥滩。The reservoir shrank to cracked mud after the third year of drought.
sceneCN: 这里 drought 指「持续异常少雨、造成缺水的时期」（第 1 个义项：气象干旱）；句意为连续第三年干旱之后，水库缩成龟裂泥滩。图中可辨识物件：泥滩裂缝、悬空的旧船坞、细水线、岸边枯草。

pos.zh: 干旱；旱灾；长期匮乏（可数或不可数）

senses.title: A long period of low rainfall
senses.definition: a prolonged period in which rainfall falls well below the normal for that place and season
senses.definitionCN: 降水明显低于该地与季节常值的持续时期
senses.example: The reservoir shrank to cracked mud after the third year of drought.
senses.exampleCN: 连续第三年干旱之后，水库缩成龟裂的泥滩。
senses.why: drought is defined against a local normal, so the same rainfall can be a drought in one place and a wet year in another.
senses.whyCN: 干旱是相对于当地常值定义的，同样的雨在一地算旱，在另一地算湿年。

senses.title: Agricultural drought
senses.definition: the soil-moisture shortfall that harms crops at their sensitive growth stages
senses.definitionCN: 在作物敏感生长期造成损害的土壤水分亏缺
senses.example: Rain fell in June, but an agricultural drought had already ruined the maize.
senses.exampleCN: 六月下了雨，但农业干旱早已毁掉玉米。
senses.why: rain that arrives after the critical stage does not undo the damage, so farms experience drought differently from weather stations.
senses.whyCN: 关键期之后才来的雨挽不回损失，因此农田所经历的干旱与气象站不同。

senses.title: Hydrological drought
senses.definition: the lagged shortage of streamflow, groundwater and reservoir storage after rainfall deficits
senses.definitionCN: 降水亏缺之后，河流流量、地下水与水库蓄水滞后出现的不足
senses.example: Hydrological drought persisted for two years after the rains returned.
senses.exampleCN: 雨回来后，水文干旱仍持续了两年。
senses.why: catchments store water, so rivers and wells record drought later and recover more slowly than the sky does.
senses.whyCN: 流域会蓄水，因此河流与水井记录干旱更晚，恢复也比天空更慢。

senses.title: Socioeconomic drought
senses.definition: the shortfall that appears when demand for water, food or power exceeds supply under dry conditions
senses.definitionCN: 干旱条件下，对水、食物或电力的需求超过供给所出现的短缺
senses.example: The city's socioeconomic drought hit when reservoirs failed and demand kept rising.
senses.exampleCN: 水库见底而需求仍在上升时，城市的社会经济干旱爆发。
senses.why: the shortage is produced by the balance of supply and demand, not by rainfall alone.
senses.whyCN: 短缺由供给与需求的平衡造成，而非仅由降水造成。

senses.title: A seasonal dry spell
senses.definition: the predictable dry season of a monsoon or Mediterranean climate, which farmers plan around
senses.definitionCN: 季风或地中海气候中可预期的旱季，农民据此安排耕作
senses.example: The seasonal drought lasts from November to April here.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的季节性干旱从十一月持续到四月。
senses.why: a dry season is normal, so drought becomes a question of degree: longer or harder than the usual dry spell.
senses.whyCN: 旱季本身正常，因此干旱变成程度问题：比通常的旱段更长或更烈。

senses.title: A figurative scarcity of anything
senses.definition: a prolonged shortage of something other than water, such as goals, funding or talent
senses.definitionCN: 水以外事物的长期短缺，如进球、资金或人才
senses.example: The club ended a ten-year drought without a title.
senses.exampleCN: 俱乐部结束了十年无冠的荒。
senses.why: the metaphor transfers 'no rain for too long' to any supply that has dried up.
senses.whyCN: 这一比喻把「太久没下雨」移到任何已干涸的供给上。

senses.title: Classifying drought severity
senses.definition: the grading of drought by indices such as the Palmer index or the standardised precipitation index
senses.definitionCN: 用帕尔默指数或标准化降水指数等指标对干旱分等
senses.example: The state declared drought stage three after the index fell for six months.
senses.exampleCN: 指数连续六个月下降后，州里宣布三级干旱。
senses.why: management needs thresholds, so a continuous deficit is divided into discrete stages that trigger rules.
senses.whyCN: 管理需要阈值，于是连续的亏缺被分成可触发规则的离散阶段。

senses.title: Drought as a slow disaster
senses.definition: a natural hazard that develops slowly, spreads widely and does most of its damage through food and water systems
senses.definitionCN: 发展缓慢、范围广、主要经食物与水系统造成损害的自然灾害
senses.example: Drought kills more livestock than any single storm.
senses.exampleCN: 干旱杀死的牲畜多过任何一场单独的风暴。
senses.why: unlike a flood, drought has no clear start, which is exactly why it is under-reported as a disaster.
senses.whyCN: 与洪水不同，干旱没有明确起点，这正是它作为灾害被少报的原因。

intro.en: Drought is a native English word from Old English drugað 'dryness', built on a verb for drying, and related to dry.
intro.cn: drought 是英语本族词，来自古英语 drugað「干燥」，由表示「使干」的动词构成，并与 dry 同族。

items.en: Drugað meant 'dryness' and was formed from drugian 'to dry', a Germanic verb of uncertain deeper origin.
items.cn: drugað 意为「干燥」，由 drugian「使干」构成，后者是更深来源不确定的日耳曼动词。

items.en: The stock behind both drought and dry is usually reconstructed as *draugiz 'dry', a form not directly attested.
items.cn: drought 与 dry 背后的共同词干通常重构为 *draugiz「干燥」，这一形式没有直接书证。

items.en: Middle English kept the word with the -ght ending that also appears in daughter and night, and fixed it as the noun for dry weather.
items.cn: 中古英语保留这个词，并带上也见于 daughter、night 的 -ght 词尾，固定为指干旱天气的名词。

items.en: From the nineteenth century drought extended figuratively to any long shortage, as in a scoring drought.
items.cn: 从 19 世纪起，drought 比喻性地扩展到任何长期短缺，如「进球荒」。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper root): the relation to dry is accepted, but the pre-Germanic root is a reconstruction; the exact first citation of the figurative sense is not securely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词根）：与 dry 的关系被接受，但其日耳曼语之前词根属重构；比喻义的最早书证年代不可靠。

note.en: Group one separates the drought family and near spellings; group two separates the shortage words that are not a period of low rain.
note.cn: 第一组区分 drought 词族与相近拼写；第二组区分并非「少雨时期」的短缺词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning prone to drought, used of soils or regions; it is rare in modern prose.
entries.definitionCN: 意为易旱的形容词，用于土壤或地区；现代书面语中少见。

entries.definition: The everyday adjective for lacking moisture; it shares the same Germanic stock as drought.
entries.definitionCN: 表示缺水的日常形容词；与 drought 共享同一日耳曼词干。

entries.definition: Describing a plant or variety that can resist drought damage, a compound built on the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 形容能抵抗干旱损害的植物或品种，由该名词构成的复合词。

entries.definition: Land degradation to desert; drought can trigger it, but it is a lasting change of land, not a period.
entries.definitionCN: 土地退化为荒漠；干旱可触发它，但它是土地的持久变化，不是一段时期。

entries.definition: A short run of dry weather; drought is longer and is measured against a local normal.
entries.definitionCN: 一段较短的干燥天气；干旱更长，并要对照当地常值。

entries.definition: The resulting lack of usable water; a drought is one of its causes, along with demand and leakage.
entries.definitionCN: 由此产生的可用水不足；干旱是原因之一，需求与漏损也会造成。

entries.definition: The long-term climatic dryness of a place; drought is a departure from that place's normal.
entries.definitionCN: 某地长期的气候干燥；干旱是对该地常值的偏离。

entries.definition: A general shortage of any resource; it is the wider category to which figurative drought belongs.
entries.definitionCN: 任何资源的普遍短缺；是比喻性 drought 所属的更大类别。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Old English drugað 'dryness' is the direct ancestor.
normal.cn: 古英语 drugað「干燥」是直接祖先。

normal.en: The family runs drought, droughty, drought-resistant, drought-stricken.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 drought、droughty、drought-resistant、drought-stricken。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: severe drought, prolonged drought, drought relief, break the drought.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：严重干旱、长期干旱、抗旱救济、结束干旱。

normal.en: Four kinds: meteorological, agricultural, hydrological, socioeconomic.
normal.cn: 四种类型：气象、农业、水文、社会经济。

normal.en: The image is a reservoir turned to cracked mud with an stranded jetty.
normal.cn: 意象是水库变成龟裂泥滩，船坞搁在干岸上。

abstract.en: Think of a clock that has stopped but nobody can say when.
abstract.cn: 想象一只停了的钟，谁也说不出是哪一刻停的。

abstract.en: Think of a team scoring no goals for a decade, and the word borrowed from weather.
abstract.cn: 想象一支球队十年不进球，于是借用了天气的词。

abstract.en: Think of a debt that grows while the rain is absent.
abstract.cn: 想象一笔在无雨时不断增长的债。

examples.en: The drought lasted four years and emptied every farm dam.
examples.cn: 这场干旱持续四年，抽干了每个农用蓄水池。

examples.en: Drought relief reached the district only in the second year.
examples.cn: 抗旱救济到第二年才抵达该区。

examples.en: The orchestra ended its drought of recordings with a new album.
examples.cn: 乐团以一张新专辑结束了长期的录音空白。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「drought」读音近「照特」——太阳特别照，雨一直不来 → 干旱

root: 古英语 drugað「干燥」← drugian「使干」，与 dry 同出日耳曼词干 *draugiz（重构形式）。更深词源不确定，无拉丁同族。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses separate the weather period from its soil, river, demand and seasonal forms, then extend it to any long scarcity and to disaster management.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项把天气时期与其土壤、河流、需求、季节形式分开，再扩展到任何长期匮乏与灾害管理。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a water body withdrawing and leaving its old shoreline exposed.
core.cn: 核心意象：水体退去，露出旧日的岸线。

branches.en: WEATHER: a deficit against local normal, whether unexpected or seasonal.
branches.cn: 天气：对当地常值的亏缺，无论突发还是季节性。

branches.en: DELAY: soil dries first, then rivers and wells record the loss later.
branches.cn: 延迟：土壤先干，河流与水井更晚记录损失。

branches.en: DEMAND: shortage appears where supply and use no longer balance.
branches.cn: 需求：供给与使用不再平衡之处，短缺才出现。

branches.en: METAPHOR: any supply can be said to have gone without rain.
branches.cn: 比喻：任何供给都可被说成「久未下雨」。

branches.en: GOVERNANCE: thresholds turn a slow process into stages, warnings and relief.
branches.cn: 治理：阈值把缓慢过程变成阶段、警报与救济。

intro.en: Drought is a native noun that forms compounds freely, especially with resistant and tolerant for plant breeding.
intro.cn: drought 是本族名词，可自由构成复合词，尤其与 resistant、tolerant 组合用于植物育种。

latinIntro.en: Drought has no Latin element; the -ant in resistant and tolerant is Latin-derived, but it belongs to those adjectives, not to drought.
latinIntro.cn: drought 没有拉丁成分；resistant 与 tolerant 中的 -ant 虽源自拉丁，却属于那两个形容词，而非 drought。

items.example: The drought broke in early autumn.
Drought-resistant millet survives on little rain.
items.exampleCN: 抗旱黍靠少量雨水存活。
耐旱灌木适合干旱庭园。

items.example: In a drought year the wells fail first.

items.meaning: end a dry period or a long failure
items.example: The storm broke the drought at last.
items.exampleCN: 这场风暴终于结束了干旱。

definition_zh: n. 苦差事；单调乏味的劳作；沉重的杂务
definition_en: hard dull work that tires you and gives no satisfaction, especially work repeated day after day
core_image: 一双手泡在冷水里搓洗成堆的盘子，窗外天黑了又亮；一个人弓着背在田里一行行锄草，日头从东移到西；办公桌上文件堆成小山，每份都只等盖同一个章
scene: 厨房水槽里堆着还没洗的盘子，水已经凉了，窗外的天黑了又亮。She spent the whole morning on the drudgery of washing up.
sceneCN: 这里 drudgery 指「令人疲惫又毫无满足感的艰苦乏味工作」（第 1 个义项：苦差事）；句意是她整个上午都耗在洗碗这件苦差事上。图中可辨识物件：冷水、成堆的盘子、黑了又亮的窗。

pos.zh: 苦差事；单调乏味的劳作；沉重的杂务

senses.title: Hard dull work
senses.definition: hard dull work that tires you and gives no satisfaction
senses.definitionCN: （名词）令人疲惫又毫无满足感的艰苦乏味工作
senses.example: She spent the whole morning on the drudgery of washing up.
senses.exampleCN: 她整个上午都耗在洗碗这件苦差事上。
senses.why: A pair of hands in cold water works through a pile of plates while the window goes dark and light again.
senses.whyCN: 一双手在冷水里对付成堆的盘子，窗外的天黑了又亮。

senses.title: The daily grind
senses.definition: boring work that must be repeated day after day without change
senses.definitionCN: （名词）必须日复一日重复、毫无变化的乏味工作
senses.example: The machine freed them from the drudgery of weeding by hand.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器把他们从手工锄草的单调劳作中解放出来。
senses.why: A bent back moves along one row of weeds while the sun crosses the whole sky.
senses.whyCN: 一个弓着的背沿着一行杂草移动，太阳走过整片天空。

senses.title: A heap of small chores
senses.definition: a mass of small unpleasant jobs that fills a whole day
senses.definitionCN: （名词）填满一整天的大量细小烦人杂务
senses.example: The form filling was pure drudgery, but it had to be done.
senses.exampleCN: 填表格纯属苦差事，可又非做不可。
senses.why: A desk holds a small mountain of papers and each one only needs the same stamp.
senses.whyCN: 办公桌上文件堆成小山，每一份都只需要同一个印章。

intro.en: Drudgery is drudge plus -ery, the ending that names a kind of work or a place of work; a drudge is the person bent over the task, and drudgery is the task itself.
intro.cn: drudgery 由 drudge 加 -ery 构成，这个后缀指称某类工作或工作场所；drudge 是弓着背干活的人，drudgery 就是那份活本身。

items.en: Old English dreogan means to endure or to carry out a task.
items.cn: 古英语 dreogan 意为忍受或完成一项任务。

items.en: Middle English druggen means to drag or to pull heavily.
items.cn: 中古英语 druggen 意为拖或沉重地拉。

items.en: English drudge appears for a person who does mean servile work.
items.cn: 英语 drudge 出现，指做低贱苦役的人。

items.en: The noun drudgery is formed with -ery for the work such a person does.
items.cn: 名词 drudgery 用 -ery 构成，指这样的人所做的活。

items.en: Writers use drudgery for the dull labour that machines begin to replace.
items.cn: 作家用 drudgery 指机器开始替代的单调劳动。

items.en: The word now covers housework, form filling and any joyless repeated task.
items.cn: 这个词如今涵盖家务、填表以及任何无乐趣的重复任务。

note.en: Drudgery shares its heavy opening with drubbing and drugging, while its neighbours name other kinds of joyless labour.
note.cn: drudgery 与 drubbing、drugging 共用沉重的开头，而它的近义词则指别的无乐趣劳动。

entries.definition: a person who does hard dull work, or to do such work
entries.definitionCN: 做苦工的人；做苦工

abstract.en: A bent back moves along one row of weeds while the sun crosses the whole sky.
abstract.cn: 一个弓着的背沿着一行杂草移动，太阳走过整片天空。

abstract.en: A desk holds a small mountain of papers and each one only needs the same stamp.
abstract.cn: 办公桌上文件堆成小山，每一份都只需要同一个印章。

examples.en: She spent the whole morning on the drudgery of washing up.
examples.cn: 她整个上午都耗在洗碗这件苦差事上。

examples.en: The machine freed them from the drudgery of weeding by hand.
examples.cn: 这台机器把他们从手工锄草的单调劳作中解放出来。

examples.en: The form filling was pure drudgery, but it had to be done.
examples.cn: 填表格纯属苦差事，可又非做不可。

dict_mnemonic.text: drudgery ＝ drudge（做苦工的人）＋ -ery（表某类工作或场所，如 bakery、slavery）＝「苦工干的活」。drudge 可能来自古英语 drēogan（忍受、完成）或中古英语 druggen（沉重地拖），两条路都指向「忍着做重活」。记三个画面：冷水里搓不完的盘子、日头下锄不完的一行行草、桌上只等盖章的文件山。escape the drudgery 是「逃离苦差事」。

root: 古英语 drēogan（忍受、完成）／中古英语 druggen（沉重地拖）→ drudge（做苦工的人）＋ -ery → drudgery（苦差事）

sensesIntro.en: Work with no joy in it: hands in cold water, a bent back along a row of weeds and a mountain of papers waiting for one stamp.
sensesIntro.cn: 毫无乐趣的活：冷水里的双手、沿着一行杂草弓着的背，以及只等一个印章的文件山。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pair of hands in cold water works through a pile of plates while a bent back moves along one row of weeds under a crossing sun
core.cn: 核心意象：一双手在冷水里对付成堆的盘子，同时一个弓着的背在移动的太阳下沿着一行杂草劳作

branches.en: Work that tires and gives nothing back.
branches.cn: 累人却毫无回报的活。

branches.en: The same work repeated every day.
branches.cn: 每天重复的同一份活。

branches.en: Many small jobs filling a day.
branches.cn: 填满一天的大量小活。

branches.en: Both are dull labour without satisfaction.
branches.cn: 两者都是没有满足感的单调劳动。

branches.en: Repetition seen as routine or as a heap.
branches.cn: 重复被看作例行或看作一堆。

intro.en: Drudgery is drudge plus -ery; -ing builds drudging, while Latin labor-, oper- and serv- name work and service from another direction.
intro.cn: drudgery 由 drudge 加 -ery 组成；-ing 造出 drudging，而拉丁语 labor-、oper- 与 serv- 从另一个方向指称劳动与役使。

latinIntro.en: Latin laborare means to work, opus a work, servus a slave and poena punishment or pain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 laborare 意为劳动，opus 意为作品、工作，servus 意为奴隶，poena 意为惩罚、痛苦。

items.meaning: a kind of work or a place

definition_zh: 鼓；鼓状容器；击鼓；持续敲击声；大力招揽
definition_en: a round percussion instrument, a large barrel-shaped container, the act or sound of beating, or to beat repeatedly and promote something loudly
core_image: 一只绷紧的圆鼓，掌心落下时空气被压成一记闷响
scene: 篝火旁，鼓手的掌心一下一下落在鼓面上，节奏渐渐加快。The drum echoed across the dark valley.
sceneCN: 这里 drum 是「鼓」（第 1 个义项：圆形的打击乐器）；句意是鼓声在黑暗的山谷里回荡。

pos.zh: 鼓；鼓状容器；鼓声
击鼓；连续敲打；大力招揽

senses.title: A percussion instrument
senses.definition: a round hollow instrument with a skin or membrane stretched over it, played by beating
senses.definitionCN: 圆形中空、蒙有皮或膜的乐器，通过敲击发声
senses.example: The drum kept a steady beat through the night.
senses.exampleCN: 那只鼓整夜保持着稳定的节拍。
senses.why: The instrument is named for the sound and the stretched skin; the word may well imitate the dull thud it makes.
senses.whyCN: 这件乐器以它的声音和绷紧的皮面得名；这个词很可能模仿了它发出的闷响。

senses.title: A barrel-shaped container
senses.definition: a large cylindrical container, often used for oil or chemicals
senses.definitionCN: 大型圆柱形容器，常用于装油或化学品
senses.example: The factory stored the oil in steel drums.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂把油储存在钢桶里。
senses.why: A drum looks like the instrument's cylinder, so the same shape-word was applied to barrels as soon as industry needed a name for them.
senses.whyCN: 桶的形状像鼓的圆柱体，所以工业一需要名称，同一个表示形状的词就用到了桶上。

senses.title: To play a drum
senses.definition: to play a drum or produce rhythm by beating it repeatedly
senses.definitionCN: 敲击鼓，或通过反复击打产生节奏
senses.example: She drummed on the table with her fingers.
senses.exampleCN: 她用手指在桌上敲个不停。
senses.why: The verb is the action behind the instrument: hands falling again and again on a surface.
senses.whyCN: 动词就是乐器背后的动作：双手反复落在同一个平面上。

senses.title: A continuous knocking sound
senses.definition: a repeated knocking or tapping sound, as of rain or fingers on a hard surface
senses.definitionCN: 反复的敲击或轻叩声，如雨点或手指打在硬面上
senses.example: Rain drummed on the metal roof.
senses.exampleCN: 雨点敲在金属屋顶上。
senses.why: Any regular series of impacts sounds like a drumbeat, so the verb describes the sound as well as the playing.
senses.whyCN: 任何有规律的连续撞击听起来都像鼓点，所以这个动词既指演奏，也指那种声音。

senses.title: To promote something loudly
senses.definition: to try hard to obtain support, customers or business by repeating the message loudly and widely
senses.definitionCN: 通过反复、广泛地宣传来争取支持、顾客或生意
senses.example: They drummed up support for the school choir.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为学校合唱团大力争取支持。
senses.why: A drummer in the street drew a crowd with noise, so drumming up business means making noise until people come.
senses.whyCN: 街头鼓手用噪音招来人群，所以 drum up business 就是一直制造动静直到人们过来。

intro.en: Drum appears in English in the sixteenth century, probably borrowed from Dutch, and the word may imitate the sound it names.
intro.cn: drum 在十六世纪出现于英语，很可能借自荷兰语，而这个词本身可能就是对所命名的声音的模仿。

items.en: The word is often felt to echo the dull thud of a beaten skin, though this cannot be proved.
items.cn: 人们常觉得这个词回响着敲击鼓面时的闷响，但这一点无法证实。

items.en: Middle Dutch tromme is the most likely immediate source, and similar forms appear in other Germanic languages.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 tromme 是最可能的直接来源，其他日耳曼语言中也有相近形式。

items.en: Drum is recorded in English in the sixteenth century, first for the instrument used in military and festive music.
items.cn: drum 在十六世纪见于英语，最初指军队与节庆音乐中使用的乐器。

items.en: The verb to drum appears, and the image of beating a surface repeatedly begins to spread to other objects and sounds.
items.cn: 动词 to drum 出现，反复敲击某一表面的意象开始扩展到其他物体和声音。

items.en: Industrial drums for oil and chemicals, and compounds such as eardrum, extend the word by shape.
items.cn: 装油与化学品的工业圆桶，以及 eardrum 等复合词，按形状扩展了这个词。

items.en: Drum up business keeps the street-drummer image alive in commerce and politics.
items.cn: drum up business 让街头鼓手的形象在商业与政治中继续活着。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on drum; the near-meaning group gathers other verbs of repeated heavy hitting.
note.cn: 形近组收由 drum 构成的词形；近义组收其他表示反复重击的动词。

entries.definition: A person who plays a drum; drum plus the agent suffix -er.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指鼓手，由 drum 加施事后缀 -er 构成。

entries.definition: The act or sound of beating a drum; the -ing form of the verb.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指击鼓的动作或鼓声，是动词的 -ing 形式。

entries.definition: A single hit on a drum, or the rhythm it makes; drum plus beat.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指一记鼓击或它形成的节奏，由 drum 加 beat 构成。

entries.definition: The membrane inside the ear that vibrates with sound; named for its drum-like shape.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指耳内随声音振动的鼓膜，因其像鼓面而得名。

entries.definition: To hit something repeatedly; the general verb behind drumming.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「反复敲打」，是 drumming 背后更通用的动词。

entries.definition: To hit hard and loudly again and again; heavier than drum.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「重击、猛敲」，比 drum 更重、更响。

entries.definition: To hit lightly and quickly; much softer than drumming.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「轻叩」，比击鼓轻得多。

entries.definition: To hit or fall with a dull heavy sound; close to the sound a drum makes.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「重击、砰然落下」，接近鼓声的闷响。

normalIntro.en: These hooks connect the instrument, the barrel and the repeated knock through one shared shape and one shared sound.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子通过共同的形状与共同的声响，把乐器、圆桶和连续的敲击连在一起。

normal.en: Drum is probably a borrowed word that echoes its own dull sound.
normal.cn: drum 很可能是个借词，本身就在模仿它那声闷响。

normal.en: The verb is regular: drum, drummed, drummed, drumming; double the final m.
normal.cn: 这个动词是规则的：drum、drummed、drummed、drumming；词尾 m 要双写。

normal.en: A steel drum is both an instrument and a barrel; the shape explains the double life.
normal.cn: steel drum 既是乐器也是圆桶，形状解释了这双重身份。

normal.en: Drum up business means make a noise until customers come.
normal.cn: drum up business 意为一直制造动静，直到顾客上门。

normal.en: Eardrum is named because the membrane inside the ear is stretched like a drum.
normal.cn: eardrum 得名是因为耳内的膜像鼓面一样绷紧。

abstract.en: Picture a round skin stretched tight, and a palm falling on it once, then again.
abstract.cn: 想象一张绷紧的圆皮，一只手掌落下去，然后再落下一次。

abstract.en: The same circle becomes a barrel standing in a factory yard, then a tiny membrane inside an ear.
abstract.cn: 同一个圆变成工厂院子里的圆桶，又变成耳朵里一小片薄膜。

abstract.en: Drum is repetition made audible: one hit repeated until it becomes a rhythm or a crowd.
abstract.cn: drum 是让重复变得可听：一次击打反复下去，直到成为节奏或招来人群。

examples.en: The drum kept a steady beat through the night.
examples.cn: 那只鼓整夜保持着稳定的节拍。

examples.en: They drummed up support for the school choir.
examples.cn: 他们为学校合唱团大力争取支持。

examples.en: Rain drummed on the metal roof.
examples.cn: 雨点敲在金属屋顶上。

dict_mnemonic.text: drum 的发音像鼓声「咚」，所以既是鼓，也是击鼓、连续敲打；圆桶因形状像鼓也叫 drum。

root: 十六世纪见于英语，最可能借自中古荷兰语 tromme，其他日耳曼语言也有相近形式；词本身可能模仿击鼓的闷响。十九世纪起按形状用于工业圆桶，并产生 eardrum 等复合词。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of drum follow one round, beaten surface: an instrument, a barrel, the act of beating, the sound it makes, and the noise of promotion.
sensesIntro.cn: drum 的五个义项都围绕一个被敲击的圆形表面：乐器、圆桶、击打动作、发出的声音，以及招揽生意的喧闹。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tight round skin that answers every blow with a low sound.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张绷紧的圆皮，每受一击便回以一声闷响。

branches.en: THE INSTRUMENT: a stretched skin over a hollow shell, played with the hands or sticks.
branches.cn: 乐器线：中空壳体上绷着一张皮，用手或鼓槌演奏。

branches.en: THE BARREL: the same cylinder in steel, holding oil instead of sound.
branches.cn: 圆桶线：同样的圆柱换成钢制，装的是油而不是声音。

branches.en: THE ACT: the verb names the repeated fall of hands on a surface.
branches.cn: 动作线：动词指双手反复落在同一平面上。

branches.en: THE SOUND: rain, fingers or feet can all drum when the knocking is regular.
branches.cn: 声音线：雨、手指或脚步只要有规律，都可以用 drum 来形容。

branches.en: THE STREET: noise becomes promotion when a drummer draws a crowd.
branches.cn: 街头线：当鼓手招来人群，噪音就变成了招揽。

intro.en: Drum is a borrowed Germanic root; English builds its family with -er, -ing and compounds such as drumbeat and eardrum.
intro.cn: drum 是借入的日耳曼语词根；英语用 -er、-ing 以及 drumbeat、eardrum 这样的复合词扩展词族。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestor; Latin tympanum, a drum, is a semantic parallel from Greek.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语祖先；拉丁语 tympanum（鼓）是源自希腊语的语义对照。

items.example: The word serves as noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个词兼作名词与动词。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「鼓手」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「击鼓；鼓声」
由本词与 beat 复合，义为「鼓点；鼓声」
由 ear 与本词复合，义为「鼓膜」

definition_zh: v. 配音；译制；给……起绰号；授予爵士称号 n. 配音；（音乐）达布混音
definition_en: to replace the spoken soundtrack of a film, to give a name or nickname, to make someone a knight, or a stripped reggae remix
core_image: 录音棚玻璃隔间里演员对着画面张口，旧的外语声轨被关掉；记者在稿子边上写下一个绰号；古堡大厅里剑面轻拍跪者的肩；调音台推子拉起，人声被抽走而鼓与贝斯带着回声砸回来
scene: 录音棚的玻璃隔间里，演员盯着画面张口，原来的外语声轨被换成母语。They dubbed the film into three languages before the release.
sceneCN: 这里 dub 指「替换或加上影片的对白声轨」（第 1 个义项：配音）；句意是发行前他们把影片译制成三种语言。图中可辨识物件：玻璃隔间、银幕上的脸、被关掉的旧声轨、话筒。

pos.zh: 配音；译制；给……起绰号；授予爵士称号
配音；（音乐）达布混音

collocations.phrase: dub him the king of pop
collocations.zh: 给他起了个流行之王的称号

senses.title: Replace the voices
senses.definition: to replace or add the spoken soundtrack of a film, especially in another language
senses.definitionCN: （动词）替换或加上影片的对白声轨，尤指换成另一种语言
senses.example: They dubbed the film into three languages before the release.
senses.exampleCN: 发行前他们把影片译制成三种语言。
senses.why: An actor behind glass opens his mouth in time with a face on the screen while the old foreign track is switched off.
senses.whyCN: 玻璃隔间里的演员跟着银幕上的脸张口，旧的外语声轨被关掉。

senses.title: Hand out a name
senses.definition: to give someone or something a name or nickname, often without official authority
senses.definitionCN: （动词）给某人或某物起名或起绰号，常非正式
senses.example: The papers dubbed the policy a quiet tax.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸给这项政策起了个「无声税」的绰号。
senses.why: A reporter writes a nickname in the margin of a draft and the name sticks to the thing.
senses.whyCN: 记者在稿子边上写下一个绰号，这个名字就粘在了那件事上。

senses.title: Touch with a sword
senses.definition: to make someone a knight by touching the shoulder with a sword
senses.definitionCN: （动词）用剑轻触肩部授予某人爵士称号
senses.example: The queen dubbed him a knight in the old hall.
senses.exampleCN: 女王在古堡大厅里授予他爵士称号。
senses.why: A flat blade rests for a moment on a kneeling shoulder and the person rises with a new title.
senses.whyCN: 平放的剑刃在跪着的肩上停了一瞬，那人起身时便有了新头衔。

senses.title: A stripped remix
senses.definition: a style of reggae music in which the rhythm is emphasised and echoes are added
senses.definitionCN: （名词）一种强调节奏并加入回声的雷鬼音乐风格
senses.example: The engineer built a dub by dropping the vocal and letting the bass echo.
senses.exampleCN: 录音师抽掉人声、让贝斯带上回声，做出一段达布混音。
senses.why: A mixing desk pulls the singing away and throws the drum back into the room twice.
senses.whyCN: 调音台把人声抽走，再把鼓声两次甩回房间。

intro.en: Dub began as a blow: the sword tap that made a knight. From striking it moved to naming, then to laying a new voice over a film, and finally to a Jamaican remix that strips a track down to drum and bass.
intro.cn: dub 起初是一击：使人成为爵士的那下剑拍。从「击打」它转到「起名」，再到给影片铺上新的声音，最后变成把曲子剥到只剩鼓与贝斯的牙买加混音。

items.en: Old English dubban means to strike or to beat.
items.cn: 古英语 dubban 意为击打。

items.en: Old French adober means to equip a man with arms.
items.cn: 古法语 adober 意为给人装备武器。

items.en: English dub is used for the sword touch that makes a man a knight.
items.cn: 英语 dub 用于使人成为爵士的那一击剑。

items.en: The verb is extended to giving a person or thing a new name.
items.cn: 这个动词被扩展为给人或物起新名字。

items.en: Dub is applied to replacing the spoken track of a film.
items.cn: dub 被用于替换影片的对白声轨。

items.en: Dub names a Jamaican remix style built on drum, bass and echo.
items.cn: dub 指称一种以鼓、贝斯与回声构成的牙买加混音风格。

note.en: Dub shares its short blunt shape with dab and cub, while its neighbours name the three things it does: supplying a voice, giving a name and granting a title.
note.cn: dub 与 dab、cub 共用短促敦实的字形，而它的近义词则指它所做的三件事：供声、起名与授衔。

entries.definitionCN: 用于软化并防水皮革的厚油脂

entries.definition: to touch or press something lightly and quickly
entries.definitionCN: 轻而快地触碰或按压

entries.definition: the young of a fox, bear, lion or similar animal
entries.definitionCN: 狐、熊、狮等动物的幼崽

entries.definition: to supply the spoken words for a character in a film
entries.definitionCN: 为影片角色提供对白

entries.definition: an informal name given to a person or thing

entries.definition: a man given a rank of honour by a ruler, or to give that rank

examples.cn: 录音师抽掉人声、让贝斯带上回声，做出一段达布混音。

dict_mnemonic.text: dub 的源头是「击打」——古英语 dubban。授爵时用剑面轻拍肩膀，那一拍就是 dub；由此引申为「给……加上一个称号」，于是有 dub him a hero。到了电影时代，「加上一层新的声音」也叫 dub，即配音、译制。1970 年代牙买加把抽掉人声、加重鼓与贝斯回声的混音叫 dub，后来衍生出 dubstep。记一条线：一拍剑 → 一个称号 → 一层新声。

root: 古英语 dubban（击打）／古法语 adober（装备武器）→ 授爵的一拍 → 起称号 → 配音 → 达布混音

sensesIntro.en: Laying something new over something old: a fresh voice on a film, a nickname on a policy, a title on a shoulder and a new echo on a stripped track.

senses.title: Not to be trusted
senses.definition: probably not honest, safe or reliable

senses.why: A head tilted to one side with one eyebrow raised and the mouth kept still.

senses.title: Of doubtful quality
senses.definition: of questionable value, quality or usefulness

senses.example: The shop sold sweets of dubious freshness.

senses.why: A jar on a shelf with a faded label and a lid that bulges a little.

intro.en: Dubious comes from Latin dubius, moving in two directions: a mind that can go either way has not settled, so the word first described the thing that causes doubt and later the person who feels it.
intro.cn: dubious 来自拉丁语 dubius「朝两个方向移动」：一颗能往两边走的心还没有定下来，所以这个词先指引起怀疑的事物，后来也指心存疑虑的人。

items.en: Latin duo means two.
items.cn: 拉丁语 duo 意为二。

items.en: Latin dubius means moving in two directions, hence uncertain.
items.cn: 拉丁语 dubius 意为朝两个方向移动，因而指不确定。

items.en: Latin dubitare means to doubt or to hesitate.
items.cn: 拉丁语 dubitare 意为怀疑或犹豫。

items.en: English dubious is borrowed for something that causes doubt.
items.cn: 英语 dubious 被借入，指引起怀疑的事物。

items.en: The word is also used of a person who feels doubt.
items.cn: 这个词也用于指心存疑虑的人。

items.en: Dubious now covers unsafe claims, hesitant people and goods of doubtful quality.
items.cn: dubious 如今涵盖不可靠的说法、犹豫的人与质量成问题的货物。

note.en: Dubious shares its ending with obvious and previous, while its neighbours name other shades of not being sure.
note.cn: dubious 与 obvious、previous 共用词尾，而它的近义词则指「拿不准」的其他层次。

entries.definition: able to be doubted or questioned
entries.definitionCN: 可被怀疑或质疑的

entries.definition: easy to see or understand, leaving no doubt
entries.definitionCN: 显而易见的

entries.definition: happening or existing before something else
entries.definitionCN: 先前的

entries.definition: feeling that something is wrong or that someone cannot be trusted
entries.definitionCN: 觉得有问题或某人不可信的

entries.definition: feeling uncertain, or unlikely to be true or good
entries.definitionCN: 不确定的；未必真实或好的

entries.definition: likely to be wrong, dishonest or of low quality
entries.definitionCN: 很可能有误、不诚实或质量低劣的

dict_mnemonic.text: dubious ＝ 拉丁语 dubius（朝两个方向移动）＋ -ous（形容词后缀）。心往两边走，就是「拿不定」：说事物是「可疑的」（a dubious claim），说人是「半信半疑的」（be dubious about），说质量是「靠不住的」（of dubious value）。同源的 doubt、dubitable 都带着这个「二」；反义词 obvious 是「摆在眼前、无需怀疑」。

root: 拉丁语 duo（二）→ dubius（朝两个方向、不确定）→ dubitare（怀疑）→ 英语 dubious（可疑的；半信半疑的）

sensesIntro.en: A mind that can go two ways: a hand stopped over a contract, a tilted head with one raised eyebrow and a jar whose lid bulges.
sensesIntro.cn: 一颗能往两边走的心：停在合同上方的手、歪着头挑起一条眉毛的人，以及盖子鼓起的罐子。

intro.en: Dubious is Latin dubi- plus -ous; -ly and -ness build dubiously and dubiousness, while duo- keeps the two and cert- names the settled opposite.
intro.cn: dubious 由拉丁语 dubi- 加 -ous 组成；-ly 与 -ness 造出 dubiously 与 dubiousness，而 duo- 保留那个「二」，cert- 指称确定下来的反面。

latinIntro.en: Latin dubius means uncertain, dubitare to doubt, duo two and certus settled or sure.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dubius 意为不确定，dubitare 意为怀疑，duo 意为二，certus 意为确定的。

definition_zh: 预定的；到期的；应付的；由于；应有的；应得之物
definition_en: expected or scheduled to happen, owed or payable, caused by, rightly required, or the share that is owed to someone
core_image: 日历上一格被圈住的日子，旁边压着一张未付的账单
scene: 站台上的电子屏一遍遍刷新到达时间，人群开始向前挪。The next train is due in ten minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 due 是「预定到达的」（第 1 个义项：按时刻表预期发生或到达）；句意是下一班火车预定十分钟后到达。

pos.zh: 预定的；到期的；应付的；由于；应有的
应得之物；应得的份额

senses.title: Expected or scheduled
senses.definition: expected or arranged to happen or arrive at a particular time
senses.definitionCN: 预期或安排在某时发生、到达
senses.example: The train is due at six.
senses.exampleCN: 火车预定六点到。
senses.why: Something due is placed on a timetable; the word marks a point that has been fixed in advance and is now being approached.
senses.whyCN: 事情被放进时刻表，due 标出一个预先定好、正在逐渐临近的时点。

senses.title: Owed or payable
senses.definition: owed as money or as a right, and therefore required to be paid or given
senses.definitionCN: 作为钱款或权利而欠下的，因此必须支付或给予
senses.example: The rent is due on the first of the month.
senses.exampleCN: 房租在每月一号到期。
senses.why: The oldest sense is debt: what one owes has a date attached, so due moves from 'owed' to 'payable now'.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是债务：欠下的东西带着一个日期，所以 due 从「欠着」走到「现在该付」。

senses.title: Caused by
senses.definition: used in the phrase due to to mean caused by or because of
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 due to，意为「由……造成」或「因为」
senses.example: The delay was due to heavy snow.
senses.exampleCN: 延误是由于大雪造成的。
senses.why: If a result is owed to a cause, the debt image explains the cause: the effect is what the cause has produced and must be credited with.
senses.whyCN: 如果结果欠着某个原因，债务意象就解释了原因：结果是原因所产生、并应记在原因账上的东西。

senses.title: Rightly required
senses.definition: proper, adequate or rightly required, as in due care or due process
senses.definitionCN: 恰当的、足够的或理应要求的，如应有的谨慎或正当程序
senses.example: The doctor acted with due care.
senses.exampleCN: 医生以应有的谨慎行事。
senses.why: What is owed can also be what is owed by duty rather than money: the care a situation rightly demands.
senses.whyCN: 所欠之物也可以是责任而非金钱所欠的：某种情形理应要求的谨慎。

senses.title: A deserved share
senses.definition: the share or recognition that is rightly owed to a person, especially in the phrase give someone their due
senses.definitionCN: 理应给予某人的份额或认可，尤用于短语 give someone their due
senses.example: Give him his due: he warned us early.
senses.exampleCN: 说句公道话：他早就警告过我们。
senses.why: The noun keeps the debt image in human form: recognition is something owed to a person and can be handed over.
senses.whyCN: 名词把债务意象保留在人的层面：认可是一种欠着某人的东西，可以被交还给他。

intro.en: Due comes from Latin debere, to owe, through Old French; the modern senses all grow out of the idea of a debt with a date.
intro.cn: due 经由古法语来自拉丁语 debere（欠），现代各个义项都从「带日期的债务」这一观念生长出来。

items.en: Latin debere meant to owe or to be under an obligation, and it is the root of debit, debt and duty as well.
items.cn: 拉丁语 debere 意为「欠」或「负有义务」，也是 debit、debt、duty 的词根。

items.en: The past participle debitum meant something owed, and it became the Latin noun for a debt.
items.cn: 过去分词 debitum 意为「所欠之物」，后来成为拉丁语中表示债务的名词。

items.en: Old French deu, the past participle of devoir, carried the sense of owed and of fitting or proper.
items.cn: 古法语 deu 是 devoir 的过去分词，兼具「所欠的」与「合适的、应有的」两层意思。

items.en: Middle English dewe already meant owed, payable and proper, so the money and duty senses arrived together.
items.cn: 中古英语 dewe 已同时表示「所欠的、应付的、恰当的」，金钱义与责任义是一起进来的。

items.en: The caused-by sense of due to is often dated to the nineteenth century; its earlier history is debated.
items.cn: due to 表「由于」的用法常被定在十九世纪，其更早的历史仍有争议。

items.en: Due date, due process and give someone their due keep the debt image in law, business and everyday fairness.
items.cn: due date、due process 与 give someone their due 让债务意象继续活在法律、商业与日常的公道里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same Latin debt family; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives of obligation, expectation and payment.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁「债务」词族的词；近义组收表示义务、预期与付款的形容词。

entries.definition: In the proper or expected way, or at the proper time; due plus -ly.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「按时地、适当地」，由 due 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: More than is proper or necessary; un- plus due.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「过分的、不应有的」，由 un- 加 due 构成。

entries.definition: Not paid or done by the expected time; over- plus due.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「过期的、迟到的」，由 over- 加 due 构成。

entries.definition: An entry recording money owed or paid out; from Latin debitum.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「借方；借记」，来自拉丁语 debitum。

entries.definition: Required to be paid, especially by a stated date; the commercial twin of due.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「应付的」，尤指在指定日期前支付，是 due 的商业近亲。

entries.definition: Not yet paid back; it states the debt without the timetable.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「被欠的、未偿的」，只说明债务，不强调时间表。

entries.definition: Thought likely to happen; close to due but without the fixed schedule.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「预期的」，接近 due，但不含固定的时刻表。

entries.definition: Still to be paid, as in owing to; also used in the phrase owing to for because of.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「尚欠的」，用于 owing to 时也可表示「由于」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from the Latin debt and follow it into timetables, causes and fairness.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从拉丁语的「欠」出发，再跟着它走进时刻表、原因与公道。

normal.en: Latin debere is to owe; due is what is owed, whether money, time or credit.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 debere 是「欠」；due 就是所欠之物，无论是钱、时间还是认可。

normal.en: A due date is the day a debt comes calling.
normal.cn: due date 就是债务上门的那一天。

normal.en: The train is due at six: the timetable owes us an arrival.
normal.cn: 火车预定六点到：时刻表欠我们一个到达。

normal.en: Due to means caused by, because the effect is owed to the cause.
normal.cn: due to 意为「由于」，因为结果欠着原因。

normal.en: Give someone their due means hand over the recognition they are owed.
normal.cn: give someone their due 意为把欠他们的那份认可交还给他们。

abstract.en: Picture a calendar square circled in red, with a bill pinned beside it.
abstract.cn: 想象日历上一格被红笔圈住，旁边钉着一张账单。

abstract.en: The same circle moves onto a platform clock, then onto a courtroom schedule.
abstract.cn: 同一个圈又移到站台的钟上，再移到法庭的日程上。

abstract.en: Due is time turned into an obligation: something will arrive, or something must be paid.
abstract.cn: due 是被时间变成义务的东西：某物即将到达，或某物必须支付。

examples.en: The train is due at six.
examples.cn: 火车预定六点到。

examples.en: The report is due next Friday.
examples.cn: 报告下周五到期。

examples.en: The delay was due to heavy snow.
examples.cn: 延误是由于大雪造成的。

dict_mnemonic.text: due 与 debt、debit 同出拉丁语「欠」：欠钱是到期应付，欠时间是预定到达，欠原因就是「由于」。

root: 经由古法语 deu 来自拉丁语 debere「欠、负有义务」，其过去分词 debitum 意为「所欠之物」，也是 debt、debit、duty 的来源。中古英语 dewe 已兼有「所欠的」与「应有的」两义；表「由于」的 due to 常被定在十九世纪。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of due all turn one debt into a deadline: a scheduled arrival, money to pay, a cause to credit, care that is required, and recognition that is owed.
sensesIntro.cn: due 的五个义项都把同一笔「债」变成期限：预定的到达、该付的钱、该记在账上的原因、理应的谨慎，以及应得的认可。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a circled date on a calendar with an unpaid bill pinned beside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：日历上圈出的一个日子，旁边钉着一张未付的账单。

branches.en: THE LEDGER: money owed and now payable on a stated date.
branches.cn: 账簿线：欠下的钱，如今在约定日期应付。

branches.en: THE TIMETABLE: an arrival or event owed to us by the schedule.
branches.cn: 时刻表线：时刻表欠我们的一个到达或事件。

branches.en: THE CAUSE: an effect is owed to the reason that produced it.
branches.cn: 原因线：结果欠着产生它的那个原因。

branches.en: THE DUTY: what a situation rightly demands, such as due care or due process.
branches.cn: 责任线：某种情形理应要求的东西，如应有的谨慎或正当程序。

branches.en: THE CREDIT: the recognition a person is owed and should receive.
branches.cn: 认可线：一个人应得并应当得到的认可。

intro.en: Due is a Latin-derived adjective; English adds -ly, un- and over-, and borrows the same root in debit and duty.
intro.cn: due 是源自拉丁语的形容词；英语加 -ly、un-、over-，并在 debit 与 duty 中借用了同一词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin debere and its participle debitum are recorded forms, so only the deeper Indo-European origin is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 debere 及其分词 debitum 都是有记录的形式，只有更早的印欧语来源属于重构。

items.example: The adjective carries both the debt and the duty senses.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词同时带有债务与责任两层意思。

items.example: The verb is the root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是整个词族的根。

items.example: Duty comes from the same French branch.
items.exampleCN: duty 来自同一支法语来源。

items.meaning: an entry of money owed or paid
items.meaningCN: 记录欠款或支出的账项

latinEntries.meaning: to owe, to be under an obligation

intro.en: Duet is Italian duetto, a little piece for two, built on Latin duo; the shrinking ending makes it a small work, and the two is the whole point of it.
intro.cn: duet 来自意大利语 duetto「给两个人的小曲」，建立在拉丁语 duo 之上；指小后缀让它成为一部小作品，而「二」正是它的全部要点。

items.en: Latin duo means two.
items.cn: 拉丁语 duo 意为二。

items.en: Italian duo keeps the Latin word for a pair of performers.
items.cn: 意大利语 duo 保留拉丁词，指一对表演者。

items.en: Italian duetto is the diminutive, a little piece for two.
items.cn: 意大利语 duetto 是指小形式，意为给两个人的小曲。

items.en: English duet is borrowed for a composition for two voices or instruments.

items.en: The verb duet appears for performing such a piece together.

items.en: Duet is also used loosely for any matched pair acting together.
items.cn: duet 也宽泛地用于指任何相配的一对共同行动。

note.en: Duet looks like duel and duct, but its neighbours name the pair itself and the larger group it belongs to.
note.cn: duet 形似 duel 与 duct，而它的近义词则指那一对本身以及它所属的更大群体。

dict_mnemonic.text: duet ＝ 意大利语 duetto ＝ duo（二）＋ 指小后缀 -etto ＝「给两个人的小曲」。所以 duet 的关键永远是「二」：两个声部是二重唱，两件乐器是二重奏。同源的 duo 指「二人组合」，dual 指「双重的」，而 duel（决斗）也是两个人——只是他们对着干而不是合着唱。记画面：舞台两侧各一支话筒，声音在中央汇成一条线。

root: 拉丁语 duo（二）→ 意大利语 duetto（给两个人的小曲）→ 英语 duet（二重唱；二重奏）
